title: Olife client
creator: olife
description: Minimal Olife client: gateway handshake/auth, chunks/blocks/entities replication with interpolation, player input, chat; runs as a headless bot (random walk, place/break) or as the F2F client. UX round 1: the user's original editor layout (scripts panel, profiler, entity settings), models/icons/sounds from the 0.30.6 prototype (Andryha), one action per tool press, Shift+RMB/LMB on the last opened entity.
